entries.english_definition: The brother of a parent or the husband of an aunt.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဦးလေး
entries.example_sentence: My uncle lives nearby.

entries.english_definition: The sister of a parent or the wife of an uncle.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဒေါ်
entries.example_sentence: My aunt is a teacher.

entries.english_definition: A device used to call or talk to people.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖုန်း
entries.example_sentence: My phone is on the table.

entries.english_definition: An electronic machine used to work with information.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကွန်ပျူတာ
entries.example_sentence: I use a computer at school.

entries.english_definition: An image made by drawing, painting or photography.
entries.example_sentence: This picture is beautiful.

entries.english_definition: A container used to carry things.
entries.burmese_meaning: အိတ်
entries.example_sentence: The bag is under the chair.

entries.english_definition: Coins and notes used to buy things.
entries.example_sentence: I need money for the bus.

entries.english_definition: A small object used to open a lock.
entries.example_sentence: Where is the key?

entries.english_definition: Clothing worn on the upper body.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရှပ်အင်္ကျီ
entries.example_sentence: He wears a blue shirt.

entries.english_definition: Something worn on a foot for protection.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖိနပ်
entries.example_sentence: My shoe is wet.

entries.english_definition: A piece of furniture used for sleeping.
entries.burmese_meaning: အိပ်ရာ၊ ကုတင်
entries.example_sentence: The cat sleeps on my bed.

entries.english_definition: An enclosed space inside a building.
entries.burmese_meaning: အခန်း
entries.example_sentence: My room is small.

entries.english_definition: The room where food is prepared and cooked.
entries.burmese_meaning: မီးဖိုခန်း
entries.example_sentence: My mother is in the kitchen.

entries.english_definition: A room with a toilet or facilities for washing.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရေချိုးခန်း၊ အိမ်သာပါသောအခန်း
entries.example_sentence: The bathroom is clean.

entries.english_definition: A device that shows the time.
entries.burmese_meaning: နာရီ (အချိန်ပြကိရိယာ)
entries.example_sentence: The clock is on the wall.

entries.english_definition: A table used for studying or office work.
entries.example_sentence: My books are on the desk.

entries.english_definition: The part of the body above the neck.
entries.example_sentence: He has a hat on his head.

entries.english_definition: The part of the body at the end of the arm.
entries.burmese_meaning: လက်
entries.example_sentence: Please wash your hands.

entries.english_definition: The part of the body used for seeing.
entries.example_sentence: I have two eyes.

entries.english_definition: The part of the body used for hearing.
entries.example_sentence: She has a small ear.

entries.english_definition: The part of the face used for smelling and breathing.
entries.example_sentence: My nose is cold.

entries.english_definition: The part of the face used for eating and speaking.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပါးစပ်
entries.example_sentence: Open your mouth, please.

entries.english_definition: The front part of the head.
entries.burmese_meaning: မျက်နှာ
entries.example_sentence: Wash your face.

entries.english_definition: The thin strands growing on a person's head.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆံပင်
entries.example_sentence: Her hair is long.

entries.english_definition: The part of the body at the end of a leg.
entries.example_sentence: My left foot hurts.

entries.english_definition: A small animal often kept as a pet.
entries.example_sentence: My cat is sleeping.

entries.english_definition: An animal often kept as a pet and known for barking.
entries.example_sentence: The dog is friendly.

entries.english_definition: An animal with feathers and wings.
entries.burmese_meaning: ငှက်
entries.example_sentence: The bird is in the tree.

entries.english_definition: An animal that lives in water and has gills.
entries.example_sentence: The fish swims in the river.

entries.english_definition: A large animal that people sometimes ride.
entries.burmese_meaning: မြင်း
entries.example_sentence: The horse is running.

entries.english_definition: A large farm animal often kept for milk.
entries.example_sentence: The cow eats grass.

entries.english_definition: A small animal with long ears.
entries.burmese_meaning: ယုန်
entries.example_sentence: The rabbit is white.

entries.english_definition: Small grains of food that are cooked and eaten.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆန်၊ ထမင်း
entries.example_sentence: We eat rice for lunch.

entries.english_definition: Food made from flour and baked.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပေါင်မုန့်
entries.example_sentence: I eat bread for breakfast.

entries.english_definition: Food with a shell laid by a bird such as a chicken.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဥ၊ ကြက်ဥ
entries.example_sentence: I eat an egg every day.

entries.english_definition: A white drink produced by some animals.
entries.example_sentence: She drinks milk in the morning.

entries.english_definition: A farm bird kept for eggs or meat.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကြက်
entries.example_sentence: There is a chicken in the garden.

entries.english_definition: A long curved fruit with yellow skin when ripe.
entries.example_sentence: I eat a banana after lunch.

entries.english_definition: A round vegetable that grows under the ground.
entries.burmese_meaning: အာလူး
entries.example_sentence: The potato is hot.

entries.english_definition: A liquid food made by cooking vegetables, meat or other ingredients.
entries.example_sentence: The soup is warm.

entries.english_definition: To move on foot at a normal speed.
entries.burmese_meaning: လမ်းလျှောက်သည်
entries.example_sentence: We walk to school.

entries.english_definition: To move on foot faster than walking.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြေးသည်
entries.example_sentence: I run in the park.

entries.english_definition: To rest with your body supported by a chair or the ground.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထိုင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Please sit here.

entries.english_definition: To be upright on your feet.
entries.burmese_meaning: မတ်တတ်ရပ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: I stand near the door.

entries.english_definition: To rest with your eyes closed and be unaware of your surroundings.
entries.burmese_meaning: အိပ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: I sleep eight hours.

entries.english_definition: To stop sleeping.
entries.burmese_meaning: အိပ်ရာနိုးသည်
entries.example_sentence: I wake at seven.

entries.english_definition: To say words aloud.
entries.burmese_meaning: စကားပြောသည်
entries.example_sentence: I speak English at school.

entries.english_definition: The Earth and all the people and places on it.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကမ္ဘာကြီး
entries.example_sentence: People around the world speak different languages.

entries.english_definition: A person's experience of being alive.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဘဝ
entries.example_sentence: Living in a new city changed her life.

entries.english_definition: From one side or end of a place to the other.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်ဖက်မှ တစ်ဖက်သို့ ဖြတ်သန်း၍
entries.example_sentence: We walked through the park to reach the station.

entries.english_definition: During the time that something else is happening.
entries.burmese_meaning: နေစဉ်၊ အချိန်အတွင်း
entries.example_sentence: I listened to music while I cooked dinner.

entries.english_definition: One piece or section of a larger whole.
entries.burmese_meaning: အစိတ်အပိုင်း
entries.example_sentence: The final part of the lesson is a short quiz.

entries.english_definition: Of a higher quality or more suitable than something else.
entries.example_sentence: The second plan is better for our budget.

entries.english_definition: A group of people who work or play together.
entries.burmese_meaning: အသင်း၊ အဖွဲ့
entries.example_sentence: Our team meets every Monday morning.

entries.english_definition: A person whose name or identity is not known or stated.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ယောက်
entries.example_sentence: Someone left an umbrella on the bus.

entries.english_definition: Used to say that something is necessary or required.
entries.burmese_meaning: မဖြစ်မနေ လုပ်ရမည်
entries.example_sentence: You must wear a helmet at work.

entries.english_definition: To let another person see something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြသည်၊ ပြသသည်
entries.example_sentence: Can you show me the picture?

entries.english_definition: A business that sells goods or services.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကုမ္ပဏီ၊ လုပ်ငန်း
entries.example_sentence: She works for a small company.

entries.english_definition: Several people or things considered together.
entries.burmese_meaning: အုပ်စု
entries.example_sentence: Our group meets every Saturday.

entries.english_definition: People in a community or society in general.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြည်သူလူထု
entries.example_sentence: The library is open to the public.

entries.english_definition: A set of connected parts that work together.
entries.burmese_meaning: စနစ်
entries.example_sentence: The new system keeps track of our orders.

entries.english_definition: A particular situation or example of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အခြေအနေ၊ ဖြစ်ရပ်
entries.example_sentence: In this case, we should wait.

entries.english_definition: One human being considered as an individual.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး
entries.example_sentence: Only one person can enter at a time.

entries.english_definition: To make or become different.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြောင်းလဲသည်
entries.example_sentence: We need to change the meeting time.

entries.english_definition: As much or as many as needed.
entries.example_sentence: We have enough chairs for everyone.

entries.english_definition: To help someone succeed or manage a difficulty.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကူညီပံ့ပိုးသည်
entries.example_sentence: My colleagues support me when I need help.

entries.english_definition: The ability to control or influence what happens.
entries.example_sentence: The manager has the power to approve requests.

entries.english_definition: To think that something is true.
entries.burmese_meaning: ယုံကြည်သည်
entries.example_sentence: I believe his explanation.

entries.english_definition: Paid work that someone does regularly.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလုပ်အကိုင်
entries.example_sentence: She found a new job in a factory.

entries.english_definition: One of the surfaces or edges of an object.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဘေးဘက်၊ တစ်ဖက်
entries.example_sentence: Write your name on this side of the paper.

entries.english_definition: At a time after now or after a particular event.
entries.example_sentence: I will call you later.

entries.english_definition: A long, narrow mark on a surface.
entries.example_sentence: Draw a straight line across the page.

entries.english_definition: A request to buy goods or services.
entries.example_sentence: The customer placed an order for ten boxes.

entries.english_definition: Work done to help customers or other people.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဝန်ဆောင်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The hotel provides a free shuttle service.

entries.english_definition: A period of the year with a particular type of weather.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရာသီ
entries.example_sentence: The rainy season starts in June.

entries.english_definition: A particular part of a place or region.
entries.burmese_meaning: နေရာဒေသ၊ ဧရိယာ
entries.example_sentence: This area is reserved for visitors.

entries.english_definition: Work involving buying, selling, or providing goods and services.
entries.burmese_meaning: စီးပွားရေးလုပ်ငန်း၊ ကုန်သွယ်မှု
entries.example_sentence: Her family runs a small business near the market.

entries.english_definition: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with what was just said.
entries.example_sentence: The room was small; however, it was comfortable.

entries.english_definition: Not anything; no single thing.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဘာမှမရှိခြင်း၊ ဘာတစ်ခုမှမဟုတ်ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: There was nothing in the empty box.

entries.english_definition: Used to say what is true, especially when it differs from what someone expected.
entries.burmese_meaning: တကယ်တော့၊ အမှန်တကယ်
entries.example_sentence: I thought it was Tuesday, but it is actually Wednesday.

entries.english_definition: A smaller amount of something that cannot usually be counted.
entries.example_sentence: Please add less sugar to my tea.

entries.english_definition: A social event where people meet to enjoy themselves.
entries.example_sentence: We invited our neighbours to a birthday party.

entries.english_definition: Complete, with no part missing.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်ခုလုံးသော၊ အပြည့်အစုံဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: We spent the whole afternoon cleaning the classroom.

entries.english_definition: Possibly; used when something is not certain.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖြစ်နိုင်သည်၊ ဖြစ်ကောင်းဖြစ်မည်
entries.example_sentence: Maybe we can visit the museum on Sunday.

entries.english_definition: A description of events, real or imagined, told or written for others.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပုံပြင်၊ ဇာတ်လမ်း
entries.example_sentence: My grandmother told us a funny story.

entries.english_definition: The condition of a person's body and mind.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကျန်းမာရေး၊ ကိုယ်စိတ်ကျန်းမာမှုအခြေအနေ
entries.example_sentence: Regular sleep is important for good health.

entries.english_definition: To want something to happen and believe that it might.
entries.example_sentence: I hope the rain stops before our trip.

entries.english_definition: Having great value or influence in a situation.
entries.example_sentence: It is important to check the address before sending the parcel.

entries.english_definition: Facts or details that help someone understand something.
entries.burmese_meaning: သတင်းအချက်အလက်၊ သိရှိရန်အချက်အလက်
entries.example_sentence: The notice gives information about the new bus route.

entries.english_definition: Connected with a particular area or neighbourhood.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဒေသဆိုင်ရာ၊ အနီးအနားဒေသ၏
entries.example_sentence: We bought fresh fruit from a local shop.

entries.english_definition: A series of lessons about a particular subject.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဘာသာရပ်တစ်ခုကို သင်ကြားပေးသော သင်တန်း
entries.example_sentence: She enrolled in a short English course.

entries.english_definition: A recording of moving pictures, usually with sound.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရုပ်သံမှတ်တမ်း၊ ဗီဒီယို
entries.example_sentence: We watched a video about recycling.

entries.english_definition: At a time before the present.
entries.burmese_meaning: ယခုအချိန်မတိုင်မီက
entries.example_sentence: I met her two years ago.

entries.english_definition: Something that is known or proved to be true.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမှန်တကယ်ဖြစ်သောအချက်၊ အချက်အလက်အမှန်
entries.example_sentence: It is a fact that plants need water.

entries.english_definition: One of two equal parts of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: နှစ်ပိုင်းညီညီခွဲထားသည့် တစ်ပိုင်း၊ တစ်ဝက်
entries.example_sentence: She ate half of the sandwich.

entries.english_definition: A particular stage or degree of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဆင့်၊ ပမာဏ
entries.example_sentence: This book is suitable for my English level.

entries.english_definition: The part of a person that thinks and remembers.
entries.burmese_meaning: စဉ်းစားမှတ်မိနိုင်သော စိတ်
entries.example_sentence: He changed his mind after hearing the explanation.

entries.english_definition: To begin to be something different.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖြစ်လာသည်၊ ပြောင်းလဲဖြစ်လာသည်
entries.example_sentence: She hopes to become an engineer.

entries.english_definition: The physical structure of a person or animal.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခန္ဓာကိုယ်
entries.example_sentence: Regular exercise helps keep your body healthy.

entries.english_definition: A difficulty that needs to be solved.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖြေရှင်းရန်လိုအပ်သော ပြဿနာ
entries.example_sentence: We found a simple solution to the problem.

entries.english_definition: Very nearly, but not completely.
entries.example_sentence: The classroom was almost empty.

entries.english_definition: To succeed in a game, competition, or contest.
entries.burmese_meaning: အနိုင်ရသည်
entries.example_sentence: Our team hopes to win the final match.

entries.english_definition: A thought or plan about what to do.
entries.burmese_meaning: အကြံဉာဏ်၊ စိတ်ကူး
entries.example_sentence: She had an idea for a new project.

entries.english_definition: People living in the same area or sharing an interest.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရပ်ရွာအသိုင်းအဝိုင်း၊ လူမှုအသိုင်းအဝိုင်း
entries.example_sentence: The community organised a clean-up day.

entries.english_definition: To make something happen.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖြစ်ပေါ်စေသည်၊ အကြောင်းရင်းဖြစ်စေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Heavy rain can cause flooding.

entries.english_definition: Information collected for study or use.
entries.burmese_meaning: စုဆောင်းထားသော အချက်အလက်များ
entries.example_sentence: The team checked the data before writing the report.

entries.english_definition: Relating to the main features of something rather than specific details.
entries.burmese_meaning: ယေဘုယျဖြစ်သော၊ အထွေထွေ
entries.example_sentence: This is a general guide to the city.

entries.english_definition: Events that happened in the past, especially those studied or recorded.
entries.burmese_meaning: သမိုင်း၊ အတိတ်ဖြစ်ရပ်များ
entries.example_sentence: She enjoys reading about the history of her town.

entries.english_definition: An institution where people study for degrees and conduct research.
entries.burmese_meaning: တက္ကသိုလ်
entries.example_sentence: My sister studies engineering at university.

entries.english_definition: The mixture of gases around us that people and animals breathe.
entries.burmese_meaning: လေ
entries.example_sentence: Open the window to let fresh air in.

entries.english_definition: Used to say that something is likely to happen or be true.
entries.example_sentence: We will probably arrive before lunch.

entries.english_definition: The time that will come after the present.
entries.burmese_meaning: အနာဂတ်
entries.example_sentence: He hopes to start his own business in the future.

entries.english_definition: The public service whose officers enforce the law and protect people.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရဲတပ်ဖွဲ့
entries.example_sentence: The police asked drivers to use another road.

entries.english_definition: A fact or explanation that shows why something happened.
entries.burmese_meaning: အကြောင်းရင်း
entries.example_sentence: What is the reason for the delay?

entries.english_definition: Inside a particular area, period, or limit.
entries.burmese_meaning: အတွင်း၊ သတ်မှတ်ထားသော အကန့်အသတ်အတွင်း
entries.example_sentence: Please finish the report within two days.

entries.english_definition: Having the skill or opportunity to do something.
entries.burmese_meaning: လုပ်နိုင်စွမ်းရှိသော
entries.example_sentence: She is able to explain the problem clearly.

entries.english_definition: Only one, rather than two or more.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်ခုတည်းသော
entries.example_sentence: We have a single room available tonight.

entries.english_definition: Big in size or amount.
entries.burmese_meaning: အရွယ်အစားကြီးမားသော
entries.example_sentence: A large tree stands beside the school.

entries.english_definition: Able to happen or be done.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖြစ်နိုင်သော၊ လုပ်ဆောင်နိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: Is it possible to change the meeting time?

entries.english_definition: Relating to people rather than animals or machines.
entries.example_sentence: Human decisions can sometimes be difficult.

entries.english_definition: Different from what is usual and often important.
entries.example_sentence: The school arranged a special event for parents.

entries.english_definition: One or the other of two things or people.
entries.burmese_meaning: နှစ်ခုထဲမှ တစ်ခုခု
entries.example_sentence: You can choose either colour for the cover.

entries.english_definition: To a noticeable degree, often more than expected.
entries.burmese_meaning: အတော်လေး၊ ထင်ထားသည်ထက်ပို၍
entries.example_sentence: The instructions were rather difficult to follow.

entries.english_definition: Existing in fact rather than being imagined.
entries.burmese_meaning: တကယ်ရှိသော၊ အစစ်အမှန်ဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The museum displays a real dinosaur bone.

entries.english_definition: To put something in a particular place or position.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်နေရာတွင် ထားသည်၊ ချထားသည်
entries.example_sentence: Please set the clean cups on the table.

entries.english_definition: An idea or opinion that comes into your mind.
entries.example_sentence: One thought kept me awake last night.

entries.english_definition: Not good in quality or unpleasant.
entries.example_sentence: The bad weather delayed our trip.

entries.english_definition: To have a particular meaning or intention.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဓိပ္ပာယ်ရသည်၊ ဆိုလိုသည်
entries.example_sentence: What does this warning sign mean?

entries.english_definition: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with another fact.
entries.burmese_meaning: သော်လည်း၊ ပေမယ့်
entries.example_sentence: Though the shop was busy, the staff were helpful.

entries.english_definition: The smallest amount or number compared with others.
entries.burmese_meaning: အနည်းဆုံးသော
entries.example_sentence: This option requires the least effort.

entries.english_definition: New information about events happening now or recently.
entries.burmese_meaning: သတင်း၊ နောက်ဆုံးဖြစ်ရပ်အကြောင်းအရာ
entries.example_sentence: We heard the news on the radio this morning.

entries.english_definition: A message or item shared on a website or social platform.

entries.burmese_meaning: အလွန်အရေးကြီးသော၊ မရှိမဖြစ်လိုအပ်သော
entries.example_sentence: Clean drinking water is critical during an emergency.

entries.english_definition: To continue to be in the same state or place.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆက်လက်ရှိနေသည်၊ မပြောင်းလဲဘဲနေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Please remain seated until the bus stops.

entries.english_definition: Not joined or kept together with something else.
entries.example_sentence: Keep the two orders in separate boxes.

entries.english_definition: To put your hand or finger on something.
entries.burmese_meaning: လက်ဖြင့် ထိသည်၊ တို့သည်
entries.example_sentence: Do not touch the wet paint.

entries.english_definition: Feeling unwell because of an illness.
entries.example_sentence: He stayed home because he felt sick.

entries.english_definition: To stop and hold something moving through the air.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖမ်းယူသည်
entries.example_sentence: Try to catch the ball with both hands.

entries.english_definition: The smallest living unit of an animal or plant.
entries.burmese_meaning: သက်ရှိဆဲလ်
entries.example_sentence: Every cell in the body needs energy.

entries.english_definition: A large room used for meetings or public events.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခန်းမ
entries.example_sentence: The ceremony took place in the school hall.

entries.english_definition: A large quantity or collection of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမြောက်အမြား၊ ပမာဏများစွာ
entries.example_sentence: A mass of clouds covered the mountain.

entries.english_definition: An important task that a person or group is given.
entries.burmese_meaning: တာဝန်ကြီး၊ ရည်မှန်းချက်ရှိသော လုပ်ငန်း
entries.example_sentence: The rescue team's mission was to find the hikers.

entries.english_definition: In a sincere or genuine way.
entries.burmese_meaning: စိတ်ရင်းမှန်ဖြင့်၊ အမှန်တကယ်
entries.example_sentence: I truly appreciate your help.

entries.english_definition: The feeling or level of high temperature.
entries.burmese_meaning: အပူ၊ အပူရှိန်
entries.example_sentence: The heat made the afternoon walk difficult.

entries.english_definition: A female ruler of a kingdom.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဘုရင်မ
entries.example_sentence: The queen addressed the nation on television.

entries.english_definition: A television station or a particular television service.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရုပ်မြင်သံကြားလိုင်း
entries.example_sentence: Which channel is showing the documentary?

entries.english_definition: Containing a large amount of body fat.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဆီများသော၊ ဝသော
entries.example_sentence: The vet advised a healthier diet for the fat cat.

entries.english_definition: Connected with a king, queen or their family.
entries.burmese_meaning: တော်ဝင်မိသားစုနှင့် သက်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: Visitors gathered outside the royal palace.

entries.english_definition: To provide food or drinks to someone.
entries.burmese_meaning: အစားအစာ၊ သောက်စရာ တည်ခင်းပေးသည်
entries.example_sentence: They serve breakfast from seven o'clock.

entries.english_definition: Extremely good or enjoyable.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလွန်ကောင်းမွန်သော၊ ကြည်နူးဖွယ်ကောင်းသော
entries.example_sentence: We had a wonderful evening with our friends.

entries.english_definition: The lowest part of something.
entries.example_sentence: The keys were at the bottom of the bag.

entries.english_definition: To say something that you know is not true.
entries.burmese_meaning: လိမ်ပြောသည်
entries.example_sentence: It is wrong to lie about the results.

entries.english_definition: A shape with four equal sides and four right angles.
entries.burmese_meaning: စတုရန်းပုံ
entries.example_sentence: Draw a square around the correct answer.

entries.english_definition: The outside or uppermost part of an object.
entries.burmese_meaning: မျက်နှာပြင်
entries.example_sentence: The surface of the table feels smooth.

entries.english_definition: An amount of something available for use.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထောက်ပံ့ပစ္စည်း၊ ရရှိနိုင်သည့်ပမာဏ
entries.example_sentence: The village has a limited supply of clean water.

entries.english_definition: To use something carelessly so that it is lost or not useful.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖြုန်းတီးသည်
entries.example_sentence: Do not waste water while washing the dishes.

entries.english_definition: The physical power to lift or move heavy things.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခွန်အား
entries.example_sentence: The job requires strength and patience.

entries.english_definition: The strong base on which a building is built.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဆောက်အအုံ၏ အုတ်မြစ်
entries.example_sentence: Workers checked the foundation before building the walls.

entries.english_definition: To get something useful or valuable.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရရှိသည်၊ တိုးပွားရရှိသည်
entries.example_sentence: You can gain confidence by practising every day.

entries.english_definition: To affect how someone thinks or behaves.
entries.burmese_meaning: လွှမ်းမိုးသည်၊ သက်ရောက်မှုရှိစေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Friends can influence our choices.

entries.english_definition: To become better or make something better.
entries.burmese_meaning: တိုးတက်ကောင်းမွန်စေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Regular practice can improve your speaking skills.

entries.english_definition: To stop something from happening.
entries.burmese_meaning: တားဆီးသည်
entries.example_sentence: Washing your hands can help prevent illness.

entries.english_definition: Something that makes a situation better or easier for someone.
entries.burmese_meaning: အားသာချက်
entries.example_sentence: Speaking two languages is an advantage in this job.

entries.english_definition: Knowing that something exists or is happening.
entries.burmese_meaning: သိရှိသတိပြုမိသော
entries.example_sentence: Are you aware of the new safety rules?

entries.english_definition: To choose something after thinking about the options.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆုံးဖြတ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: We must decide where to meet tomorrow.

entries.english_definition: Movement towards a better or more complete result.
entries.burmese_meaning: တိုးတက်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The students made good progress this term.

entries.english_definition: A general idea used to understand or explain something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အယူအဆ
entries.example_sentence: The teacher explained the concept with a simple drawing.

entries.english_definition: Connected with education, study, or research.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပညာရေးနှင့်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: She needs stronger academic writing skills.

entries.english_definition: Correct and without mistakes.
entries.burmese_meaning: တိကျမှန်ကန်သော
entries.example_sentence: Please check that the address is accurate.

entries.english_definition: To succeed in reaching a goal through effort.
entries.burmese_meaning: အောင်မြင်စွာ ရရှိသည်
entries.example_sentence: He worked hard to achieve his goal.

entries.english_definition: To have enough money to pay for something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဝယ်ယူရန် ငွေကြေးတတ်နိုင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: We cannot afford a new computer this month.

entries.english_definition: A group of things that share a particular feature.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမျိုးအစား၊ အုပ်စု
entries.example_sentence: Put each book in the correct category.

entries.english_definition: Closely connected with the subject being discussed.
entries.burmese_meaning: သက်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: Please include only relevant details in your answer.

entries.english_definition: Recently made or obtained, rather than old.
entries.burmese_meaning: လတ်ဆတ်သော
entries.example_sentence: We bought fresh vegetables from the market.

entries.english_definition: The size or extent of an activity or problem.
entries.burmese_meaning: အတိုင်းအတာ၊ ပမာဏ
entries.example_sentence: The scale of the project surprised the team.

entries.english_definition: The number of points gained in a game or test.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရမှတ်
entries.example_sentence: Her score improved after more practice.

entries.english_definition: Able to learn and understand things quickly.
entries.example_sentence: That smart student solved the puzzle in minutes.

entries.english_definition: To send something through the air using your hand.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပစ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Please throw the ball gently to your partner.

entries.english_definition: A ceremony in which two people get married.
entries.burmese_meaning: မင်္ဂလာဆောင်ပွဲ
entries.example_sentence: Their wedding took place in a small garden.

entries.english_definition: An important or noticeable part of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထူးခြားသည့် အင်္ဂါရပ်
entries.example_sentence: A useful feature of this phone is its long battery life.

entries.english_definition: A result or amount that someone aims to achieve.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရည်မှန်းချက်၊ သတ်မှတ်ပန်းတိုင်
entries.example_sentence: The team reached its sales target in June.

entries.english_definition: A small community in the countryside.
entries.example_sentence: The village is surrounded by green hills.

entries.english_definition: To formally ask for a job, place, or opportunity.
entries.example_sentence: You can apply for the course online.

entries.english_definition: The official power to make decisions or enforce rules.
entries.burmese_meaning: အာဏာပိုင်ခွင့်
entries.example_sentence: The manager has the authority to approve the request.

entries.english_definition: A particular way of doing something.
entries.burmese_meaning: နည်းလမ်း
entries.example_sentence: This method saves both time and energy.

entries.english_definition: In good physical or mental condition.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကျန်းမာသော
entries.example_sentence: A healthy diet includes different kinds of food.

entries.english_definition: One of several possible choices.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရွေးချယ်စရာ
entries.example_sentence: Taking the train is another option.

entries.english_definition: A problem or difficult situation.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြဿနာ၊ အခက်အခဲ
entries.example_sentence: We had trouble finding the correct address.

entries.english_definition: Separated from each other by a distance.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခွာ၍၊ အကွာအဝေးရှိလျက်
entries.example_sentence: The two chairs stood a metre apart.

entries.english_definition: Something given to another person without payment.
entries.burmese_meaning: လက်ဆောင်
entries.example_sentence: She bought a small gift for her friend.

entries.english_definition: To need something or make it necessary.
entries.burmese_meaning: လိုအပ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: This position may require weekend work.

entries.english_definition: The hard material that forms the trunk and branches of a tree.
entries.burmese_meaning: သစ်သား
entries.example_sentence: The carpenter made the table from wood.

entries.english_definition: The experiences and education that have shaped a person.
entries.burmese_meaning: နောက်ခံအတွေ့အကြုံ၊ ပညာရေးနောက်ခံ
entries.example_sentence: Her background in engineering helped her understand the design.

entries.english_definition: A name used to identify a company's products.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကုန်အမှတ်တံဆိပ်
entries.example_sentence: This brand makes durable shoes.

entries.english_definition: One hundredth of a dollar or euro.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဒေါ်လာ သို့မဟုတ် ယူရို၏ တစ်ရာပုံတစ်ပုံ
entries.example_sentence: The price increased by one cent.

entries.english_definition: To find the total number of people or things.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရေတွက်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Please count the boxes before loading them.

entries.english_definition: Coming after the third in a series.
entries.burmese_meaning: စတုတ္ထမြောက်
entries.example_sentence: Our meeting is on the fourth floor.

entries.english_definition: Relating to the mind and thinking.
entries.burmese_meaning: စိတ်ပိုင်းဆိုင်ရာ
entries.example_sentence: Reading can improve mental skills.

entries.english_definition: Mainly or for the most part.
entries.example_sentence: The audience was mostly students.

entries.english_definition: A person who legally possesses something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပိုင်ရှင်
entries.example_sentence: The owner opened the shop early.

entries.english_definition: At an earlier time.
entries.burmese_meaning: ယခင်က
entries.example_sentence: She previously worked in a hospital.

entries.english_definition: To become aware of a fact or situation.
entries.burmese_meaning: သဘောပေါက်သည်
entries.example_sentence: I didn't realize the door was locked.

entries.english_definition: To press a mouse button or select an on-screen control.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကလစ်နှိပ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Click the blue icon to open the file.

entries.english_definition: Strong trust or confidence in someone or something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ယုံကြည်မှု
entries.example_sentence: She has faith in her team's ability.

entries.english_definition: Popular styles of clothing at a particular time.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခေတ်စားသော ဝတ်စားဆင်ယင်မှုပုံစံ
entries.example_sentence: Fashion changes quickly in big cities.

entries.english_definition: Money saved or collected for a particular purpose.
entries.burmese_meaning: သတ်မှတ်ရည်ရွယ်ချက်အတွက် စုဆောင်းထားသော ရန်ပုံငွေ
entries.example_sentence: The school created a fund for new books.

entries.english_definition: An area of land higher than the land around it but smaller than a mountain.
entries.burmese_meaning: တောင်ကုန်း
entries.example_sentence: We walked up the hill before sunset.

entries.english_definition: A material such as iron or aluminium that is usually strong and conducts heat.
entries.burmese_meaning: သတ္တု
entries.example_sentence: The gate is made of metal.

entries.english_definition: A description of a person's background or interests.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကိုယ်ရေးအချက်အလက်အကျဉ်း
entries.example_sentence: She updated her online profile yesterday.

entries.english_definition: To move something towards yourself using force.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆွဲသည်
entries.example_sentence: Pull the handle gently to open the door.

entries.english_definition: To move something away from you by using force.
entries.example_sentence: Please push the door gently to open it.

entries.english_definition: A place where one person can sit.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထိုင်ခုံ၊ ထိုင်ရန်နေရာ
entries.example_sentence: She offered her seat to an older passenger.

entries.english_definition: Something that you remember from the past.
entries.burmese_meaning: အတိတ်မှ မှတ်မိနေသော အကြောင်းအရာ
entries.example_sentence: My first day at school is a happy memory.

entries.english_definition: A circular piece of jewellery worn on a finger.
entries.burmese_meaning: လက်စွပ်
entries.example_sentence: He bought a silver ring for his sister.

entries.english_definition: To increase in amount, level or number.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပမာဏ၊ အဆင့် သို့မဟုတ် အရေအတွက် တိုးလာသည်
entries.example_sentence: Food prices may rise during the holiday.

entries.english_definition: A shiny grey-white metal used to make jewellery.
entries.burmese_meaning: ငွေသတ္တု
entries.example_sentence: The artist made the necklace from silver.

entries.english_definition: To move or extend over a wider area.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဧရိယာပိုမိုကျယ်ပြန့်စွာ ပျံ့နှံ့သည်
entries.example_sentence: The fire began to spread across the dry grass.

entries.english_definition: A person who is fully grown.
entries.burmese_meaning: အရွယ်ရောက်ပြီးသူ
entries.example_sentence: Every adult attending the workshop needs a ticket.

entries.english_definition: A person who creates paintings, drawings or other art.
entries.burmese_meaning: အနုပညာလက်ရာများ ဖန်တီးသူ
entries.example_sentence: The artist painted a picture of the market.

entries.english_definition: A particular version of a book or publication.
entries.burmese_meaning: စာအုပ် သို့မဟုတ် ထုတ်ဝေမှု၏ မူကွဲတစ်ခု
entries.example_sentence: This edition includes a new chapter on travel.

entries.english_definition: According to what seems true or what people have said.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကြားသိရသည့်အရ၊ ထင်ရသလောက်
entries.example_sentence: Apparently, the meeting has been moved to Friday.

entries.english_definition: A building where people are kept as punishment for crimes.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြစ်ဒဏ်ကျခံသူများကို ထိန်းသိမ်းထားသော အကျဉ်းထောင်
entries.example_sentence: He worked as a teacher in a prison.

entries.english_definition: To deal with a difficult situation or task.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခက်ခဲသော အခြေအနေ သို့မဟုတ် တာဝန်ကို ကိုင်တွယ်ဖြေရှင်းသည်
entries.example_sentence: She can handle customer complaints calmly.

entries.english_definition: To make or create something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထုတ်လုပ်သည်၊ ဖန်တီးသည်
entries.example_sentence: The factory can produce hundreds of boxes a day.

entries.english_definition: The ability or activity of guiding a group.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဖွဲ့တစ်ဖွဲ့ကို ဦးဆောင်လမ်းညွှန်နိုင်မှု
entries.example_sentence: Her leadership helped the team finish on time.

entries.english_definition: The qualities of character that make a person different from others.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကိုယ်ရည်ကိုယ်သွေး
entries.example_sentence: Her friendly personality helps her make new friends.

entries.english_definition: The pleasant feeling when worry, pain or difficulty ends.
entries.burmese_meaning: စိတ်သက်သာရာရမှု
entries.example_sentence: He felt relief when the missing bag was found.

entries.english_definition: Refusal to accept or support a change or action.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခုခံဆန့်ကျင်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The proposal met resistance from local residents.

entries.english_definition: The business of selling goods directly to customers.
entries.burmese_meaning: လက်လီရောင်းချမှု
entries.example_sentence: She has worked in retail for five years.

entries.english_definition: A painful feeling of embarrassment or guilt.
entries.burmese_meaning: အရှက်ကွဲမှု၊ အရှက်ရမှု
entries.example_sentence: He felt shame after lying to his friend.

entries.english_definition: To a limited degree; rather than completely.
entries.burmese_meaning: အတော်အသင့်၊ တစ်စိတ်တစ်ပိုင်း
entries.example_sentence: The second proposal is somewhat more practical.

entries.english_definition: Used to express strong belief that something is true.
entries.burmese_meaning: သေချာပေါက်၊ ဧကန်မုချ
entries.example_sentence: Surely there must be a better solution.

entries.english_definition: Complete or total, without any limitation.
entries.example_sentence: The manager demanded absolute silence during the test.

entries.english_definition: The activity of promoting products or services to customers.
entries.example_sentence: Online advertising helped the shop attract customers.

entries.english_definition: Continuing without stopping or changing.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဆက်မပြတ်ဖြစ်သော၊ တည်မြဲသော
entries.example_sentence: The constant noise made it hard to study.

entries.english_definition: To make someone or something ready for an activity.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြင်ဆင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: We need to prepare the documents before the meeting.

entries.english_definition: Not worried, excited or upset.
entries.burmese_meaning: တည်ငြိမ်သော
entries.example_sentence: She remained calm during the emergency.

entries.english_definition: A person or organisation that pays for professional services.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖောက်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The consultant met a new client.

entries.english_definition: The process of becoming larger or extending.
entries.example_sentence: The company announced an expansion of its factory.

entries.english_definition: A group of countries or regions ruled by one authority.
entries.burmese_meaning: အင်ပါယာ
entries.example_sentence: The museum has an exhibition about the ancient empire.

entries.english_definition: An event that is unusual or unpleasant.
entries.burmese_meaning: မမျှော်လင့်ထားသော သို့မဟုတ် မနှစ်မြို့ဖွယ် ဖြစ်ရပ်
entries.example_sentence: The supervisor recorded the incident in the safety report.

entries.english_definition: To succeed in doing something difficult.
entries.burmese_meaning: အခက်အခဲရှိသော်လည်း အောင်မြင်စွာ လုပ်နိုင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: We managed to finish the work before the deadline.

entries.english_definition: To stop doing an activity or leave a job.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရပ်တန့်သည်၊ အလုပ်မှထွက်သည်
entries.example_sentence: He decided to quit his job and return to university.

entries.english_definition: The ability to see things with your eyes.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမြင်အာရုံ
entries.example_sentence: Her sight improved after she received new glasses.

entries.english_definition: By a large or noticeable amount or degree.
entries.burmese_meaning: သိသိသာသာ၊ အရေးပါသော အတိုင်းအတာဖြင့်
entries.example_sentence: Production costs fell significantly after the redesign.

entries.english_definition: By many people or across many places.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကျယ်ကျယ်ပြန့်ပြန့်
entries.example_sentence: This teaching method is widely used in schools.

entries.english_definition: In or across many countries throughout the world.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကမ္ဘာတစ်ဝန်းလုံးတွင်
entries.example_sentence: The company sells its products worldwide.

entries.english_definition: A date on which an important past event is remembered each year.
entries.burmese_meaning: နှစ်ပတ်လည်နေ့
entries.example_sentence: The company celebrated its tenth anniversary.

entries.english_definition: Pleasant to look at or appealing.
entries.example_sentence: The new packaging has an attractive design.

entries.english_definition: Covering a wide range of subjects or ideas.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကျယ်ပြန့်သော
entries.example_sentence: The course provides a broad understanding of management.

entries.english_definition: In large amounts or with great force.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြင်းပြင်းထန်ထန်၊ များစွာ
entries.example_sentence: It rained heavily all night.

entries.english_definition: To put something where other people cannot see it.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဝှက်ထားသည်၊ ဖုံးကွယ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Please do not hide important documents.

entries.english_definition: Letters or words that appear on a printed surface.
entries.example_sentence: The print on the label is too small to read.

entries.english_definition: The activity of giving information about events.
entries.burmese_meaning: သတင်းတင်ပြခြင်း၊ အစီရင်ခံခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: Accurate reporting helps the public understand events.

entries.english_definition: With careful attention to details.
entries.burmese_meaning: အသေအချာ၊ အနီးကပ်
entries.example_sentence: The engineer examined the drawing closely.

entries.english_definition: Very often or all the time.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမြဲမပြတ်၊ မကြာခဏ
entries.example_sentence: The schedule is constantly changing.

entries.english_definition: A competition in which a winner is chosen.
entries.example_sentence: She entered a photography contest.

entries.english_definition: Almost not at all.
entries.burmese_meaning: မ…သလောက်၊ လုံးဝနီးပါး မ…
entries.example_sentence: I could hardly hear the speaker.

entries.english_definition: The distance from the bottom to the top of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမြင့်
entries.example_sentence: Please measure the height of the box.

entries.english_definition: A machine that produces movement or power.
entries.example_sentence: The motor stopped when the power failed.

entries.english_definition: An object used to hurt people or damage things in a conflict.
entries.burmese_meaning: လက်နက်
entries.example_sentence: The guards discovered a weapon at the entrance.

entries.english_definition: In a way that is formally recognised or announced.
entries.burmese_meaning: တရားဝင်အားဖြင့်
entries.example_sentence: The new office officially opened on Monday.

entries.english_definition: A part or amount of something larger.
entries.burmese_meaning: အစိတ်အပိုင်း၊ အစားအစာတစ်ပွဲစာပမာဏ
entries.example_sentence: The waiter brought a small portion of rice.

entries.english_definition: The highest point or level reached by something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမြင့်ဆုံးအဆင့်၊ အထွတ်အထိပ်
entries.example_sentence: Demand reached its peak in December.

entries.english_definition: A change intended to improve a system or institution.
entries.example_sentence: The government proposed a reform of the tax system.

entries.english_definition: To answer or react to a message, event, or action.
entries.burmese_meaning: တုံ့ပြန်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Please respond to the request by Friday.

entries.english_definition: The period after someone permanently stops working, usually because of age.
entries.burmese_meaning: အငြိမ်းစားယူခြင်း၊ အငြိမ်းစားဘဝ
entries.example_sentence: She plans to travel after retirement.

entries.english_definition: A small part taken to represent or test a larger amount.
entries.burmese_meaning: နမူနာ
entries.example_sentence: The lab tested a sample of the water.

entries.english_definition: Less important than something else, or coming after it.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဒုတိယအဆင့်ဖြစ်သော၊ အဓိကမဟုတ်သော
entries.example_sentence: Cost is a secondary concern in this decision.

entries.english_definition: Connected with the sun or energy from sunlight.
entries.burmese_meaning: နေရောင်ခြည်ဆိုင်ရာ
entries.example_sentence: The building uses solar panels.

entries.english_definition: In a way that is not known or explained.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်နည်းနည်းဖြင့်
entries.example_sentence: Somehow, we found the missing key.

entries.english_definition: Being the final or most important aim or result.
entries.example_sentence: Our ultimate goal is to reduce waste.

entries.english_definition: Not known or identified.
entries.burmese_meaning: မသိရှိသေးသော
entries.example_sentence: The cause of the delay remains unknown.

entries.english_definition: By a machine or system without someone controlling every step.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလိုအလျောက်
entries.example_sentence: The doors close automatically.

entries.english_definition: Unable to see, or having very limited sight.
entries.burmese_meaning: မျက်မမြင်ဖြစ်သော၊ အမြင်အာရုံမရှိသော
entries.example_sentence: The museum provides audio guides for blind visitors.

entries.english_definition: Air taken into or sent out of the lungs.
entries.burmese_meaning: အသက်ရှူသွင်းထုတ်သောလေ
entries.example_sentence: Take a deep breath before you speak.

entries.english_definition: Lasting only a short time.
entries.burmese_meaning: တိုတောင်းသော၊ ခဏတာဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: We had a brief meeting after lunch.

entries.english_definition: To organise and carry out an activity.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆောင်ရွက်သည်၊ ပြုလုပ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The team will conduct a safety inspection.

entries.english_definition: A period of ten years.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆယ်စုနှစ်
entries.example_sentence: The town has changed a lot in the past decade.

entries.english_definition: To damage something so badly that it no longer exists or works.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖျက်ဆီးသည်
entries.example_sentence: The fire destroyed the old warehouse.

entries.english_definition: On or connected with the outside of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြင်ပဆိုင်ရာ
entries.example_sentence: The device has an external power supply.

entries.english_definition: An imagined situation that is unlikely to happen in real life.
entries.burmese_meaning: စိတ်ကူးယဉ်အတွေး၊ စိတ်ကူးယဉ်ကမ္ဘာ
entries.example_sentence: The novel tells a fantasy about a hidden kingdom.

entries.english_definition: To take hold of something suddenly or quickly.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလျင်အမြန်ဆုပ်ကိုင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: She grabbed her bag and ran outside.

entries.english_definition: Happening or needed without delay.
entries.burmese_meaning: ချက်ချင်းဖြစ်သော၊ အရေးပေါ်လိုအပ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The problem requires immediate attention.

entries.english_definition: The opening part of a talk, book, or report that presents its subject.
entries.burmese_meaning: နိဒါန်း၊ မိတ်ဆက်ပိုင်း
entries.example_sentence: The introduction explains the purpose of the study.

entries.english_definition: Related to a president or the office of president.
entries.burmese_meaning: သမ္မတနှင့်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The candidates took part in a presidential debate.

entries.english_definition: To identify someone or something because you have seen or known them before.
entries.burmese_meaning: မှတ်မိသည်၊ ခွဲခြားသိရှိသည်
entries.example_sentence: I did not recognize the street after the renovation.

entries.english_definition: Often and at repeated or usual times.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပုံမှန်၊ အချိန်မှန်မှန်
entries.example_sentence: The factory regularly inspects its lifting equipment.

entries.english_definition: The process or business of transporting goods, especially by sea.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကုန်ပစ္စည်းပို့ဆောင်ရေး၊ သင်္ဘောဖြင့်ကုန်ပို့ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: The shipping company confirmed the container's arrival.

entries.english_definition: To remain alive or continue to exist after danger or difficulty.
entries.burmese_meaning: အသက်ရှင်ကျန်ရစ်သည်၊ ဆက်လက်ရပ်တည်နိုင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The plants managed to survive the long dry season.

entries.english_definition: Treatment intended to improve a physical or mental condition.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကုထုံး၊ ကုသမှုနည်းလမ်း
entries.example_sentence: The doctor suggested physical therapy after the injury.

entries.english_definition: A person who sees an event happen and can describe it.
entries.burmese_meaning: မျက်မြင်သက်သေ
entries.example_sentence: A witness described what happened at the crossing.

entries.english_definition: To intend to achieve a particular result.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရည်မှန်းသည်၊ ရည်ရွယ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: We aim to reduce delivery errors this month.

entries.english_definition: The period of life when someone is a child.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကလေးဘဝ
entries.example_sentence: She spent her childhood in a small coastal town.

entries.english_definition: Related to examining or treating patients in a medical setting.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူနာစမ်းသပ်ကုသမှုနှင့်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The students gained clinical experience at the hospital.

entries.english_definition: The act of examining two or more things to find similarities and differences.
entries.example_sentence: A comparison of the two plans revealed several differences.

entries.english_definition: To win against someone in a contest, game, or conflict.
entries.burmese_meaning: အနိုင်ယူသည်၊ ရှုံးနိမ့်စေသည်
entries.example_sentence: The visiting team managed to defeat the champions.

entries.english_definition: A building where plays are performed for an audience.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဇာတ်ရုံ
entries.example_sentence: We booked seats at the theatre for Saturday.

entries.english_definition: A play, film, or show intended to make people laugh.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဟာသဇာတ်လမ်း၊ ဟာသပြဇာတ်
entries.example_sentence: The comedy made the whole audience laugh.

entries.english_definition: A system of government in which people choose their representatives.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြည်သူများက ကိုယ်စားလှယ်များကို ရွေးချယ်သည့် ဒီမိုကရေစီစနစ်
entries.example_sentence: In a democracy, citizens can vote in elections.

entries.english_definition: A manufactured material that can be shaped into many products.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပုံသွင်းနိုင်သော ပလတ်စတစ်ပစ္စည်း
entries.example_sentence: This container is made from recycled plastic.

entries.english_definition: To think something may be true without being certain.
entries.burmese_meaning: သံသယရှိသည်၊ ဖြစ်နိုင်သည်ဟု ထင်မြင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The technician began to suspect a faulty cable.

entries.english_definition: A general direction in which something is changing.

entries.english_definition: A large amount of money or valuable possessions.

entries.english_definition: Official agreement that something may happen.
entries.burmese_meaning: တရားဝင်ခွင့်ပြုချက်၊ သဘောတူအတည်ပြုချက်
entries.example_sentence: We need approval before ordering the equipment.

entries.english_definition: A large formal meeting for people with shared interests or work.
entries.burmese_meaning: ညီလာခံ၊ အကြီးစားတရားဝင်အစည်းအဝေး
entries.example_sentence: The annual convention attracted teachers from many countries.

entries.english_definition: A written or electronic record containing information.
entries.burmese_meaning: စာရွက်စာတမ်း၊ မှတ်တမ်းဖိုင်
entries.example_sentence: Please attach the document to your email.

entries.english_definition: A person who works for an employer and receives pay.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလုပ်သမား၊ ဝန်ထမ်း
entries.example_sentence: Every employee must attend the safety briefing.

entries.burmese_meaning: အင်ဂျင်နီယာ
entries.example_sentence: The engineer inspected the damaged bridge.

entries.english_definition: Equal in value, meaning, or effect to something else.

entries.example_sentence: The two qualifications are considered equivalent.

entries.english_definition: To control or use a machine or system.
entries.burmese_meaning: စက် သို့မဟုတ် စနစ်ကို လည်ပတ်အသုံးပြုသည်
entries.example_sentence: Only trained staff may operate this machine.

entries.english_definition: Agreement that allows someone to do something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခွင့်ပြုချက်
entries.example_sentence: You need permission to enter the laboratory.

entries.english_definition: An answer to a question or message.
entries.burmese_meaning: အကြောင်းပြန်စာ၊ ပြန်လည်ဖြေကြားချက်
entries.example_sentence: We received a helpful reply from the supplier.

entries.english_definition: A belief or practice passed from one generation to another.
entries.burmese_meaning: အစဉ်အလာ၊ ရိုးရာဓလေ့
entries.example_sentence: Sharing food is an important family tradition.

entries.english_definition: Related to seeing or to images.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမြင်နှင့်ဆိုင်သော၊ ရုပ်ပုံအခြေပြုသော
entries.example_sentence: The teacher used visual examples to explain the topic.

entries.english_definition: Statements expressing disapproval or pointing out faults.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဝေဖန်ချက်၊ အပြစ်ထောက်ပြမှု
entries.example_sentence: The proposal received criticism for its high cost.

entries.english_definition: In a way that achieves the intended result.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထိရောက်စွာ
entries.example_sentence: The new system allows the team to work more effectively.

entries.english_definition: Covering a large area or involving many parts.
entries.example_sentence: The building suffered extensive damage during the storm.

entries.english_definition: The process of creating or establishing something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖွဲ့စည်းတည်ထောင်ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: The formation of the committee took several weeks.

entries.english_definition: Important enough to be remembered as part of history.
entries.burmese_meaning: သမိုင်းဝင်အရေးပါသော
entries.example_sentence: The agreement was a historic moment for the town.

entries.english_definition: A change that makes something better.
entries.burmese_meaning: တိုးတက်ကောင်းမွန်မှု
entries.example_sentence: There has been a clear improvement in customer service.

entries.english_definition: A set of ideas about how to live, think, or approach an activity.
entries.burmese_meaning: အတွေးအခေါ်အယူအဆ၊ ခံယူချက်
entries.example_sentence: Her teaching philosophy encourages students to ask questions.

entries.english_definition: An agreement that ends a dispute between people or organisations.
entries.burmese_meaning: အငြင်းပွားမှုဖြေရှင်းရန် သဘောတူညီချက်
entries.example_sentence: The two companies reached a settlement without going to court.

entries.english_definition: Remaining at a similar standard or following the same pattern over time.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်သမတ်တည်းဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: His results have been consistent throughout the year.

entries.english_definition: An arrangement in which people or organisations work together.
entries.burmese_meaning: မိတ်ဖက်ပူးပေါင်းဆောင်ရွက်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The university announced a partnership with a local factory.

entries.english_definition: Most important or main.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဓိကဖြစ်သော၊ အရေးအကြီးဆုံးဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The principal reason for the delay was bad weather.

entries.english_definition: The act of protecting someone or something from attack or harm.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကာကွယ်ခြင်း၊ ခုခံကာကွယ်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The walls were built for the defence of the town.

entries.english_definition: Very useful or important, even when not expensive.

entries.english_definition: To some degree, but not extremely.
entries.burmese_meaning: အတော်အသင့်၊ အတော်လေး
entries.example_sentence: The test was fairly easy after the practice session.

entries.english_definition: To have something inside or as a part.
entries.burmese_meaning: အထဲတွင် ပါဝင်သည်၊ ထည့်သွင်းထားသည်
entries.example_sentence: These boxes contain fragile glass products.

entries.english_definition: To complete a course of study and receive a qualification.
entries.burmese_meaning: သင်တန်း သို့မဟုတ် ဘွဲ့သင်တန်းပြီးဆုံး၍ အောင်မြင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: She hopes to graduate from university next year.

entries.english_definition: An arranged time to meet someone, especially for a service or professional discussion.
entries.example_sentence: I made a dental appointment for Friday morning.

entries.english_definition: Belonging to or happening in the present period.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခေတ်ပြိုင်ဖြစ်သော၊ ယနေ့ခေတ်နှင့်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The museum displays contemporary art from local artists.

entries.english_definition: At the beginning, before something changes.
entries.burmese_meaning: အစပိုင်းတွင်၊ ပထမဦးစွာ
entries.example_sentence: Initially, we planned to travel by train.

entries.english_definition: Applying to or involving everyone or everything in a group.
entries.burmese_meaning: အားလုံးနှင့်သက်ဆိုင်သော၊ အများနှင့်သက်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: Access to clean water is a universal concern.

entries.english_definition: Not cooked or processed.
entries.burmese_meaning: အစိမ်းဖြစ်သော၊ မချက်ပြုတ်ရသေးသော
entries.example_sentence: Wash your hands after handling raw chicken.

entries.english_definition: A person who sings, especially professionally.
entries.example_sentence: The singer performed three new songs.

entries.english_definition: Water in the form of gas, especially when heated.
entries.example_sentence: Steam rose from the bowl of soup.

entries.english_definition: A person in charge of a military group or operation.
entries.burmese_meaning: စစ်ဘက်ဆိုင်ရာ အမိန့်ပေးခေါင်းဆောင်
entries.example_sentence: The commander explained the safety plan to the unit.

entries.english_definition: Completely correct or precise, without approximation.
entries.burmese_meaning: အတိအကျဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: Please record the exact weight of each package.

entries.english_definition: To repeat or write someone's words exactly.
entries.burmese_meaning: စကားကို မူရင်းအတိုင်း ကိုးကားဖော်ပြသည်
entries.example_sentence: The report will quote the expert's statement.

entries.english_definition: To fasten something using string or a similar material.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကြိုးဖြင့် ချည်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Use a strong rope to tie the boxes together.

entries.english_definition: Showing good judgement based on knowledge or experience.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမြော်အမြင်ရှိသော
entries.example_sentence: It was wise to check the contract before signing.

entries.english_definition: Located inside something or closer to its centre.
entries.example_sentence: The building has an inner courtyard.

entries.english_definition: To move something to a higher position.
entries.burmese_meaning: မြှောက်တင်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Two workers helped lift the heavy crate.

entries.english_definition: Happening or produced once every month.
entries.burmese_meaning: လစဉ်ဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: Our monthly meeting takes place on Friday.

entries.english_definition: A tall, narrow building or part of a building.
entries.example_sentence: The clock tower stands beside the market.

entries.english_definition: Only just; by a very small amount.
entries.burmese_meaning: အနိုင်နိုင်၊ မဖြစ်စလောက်သာ
entries.example_sentence: She could barely hear the speaker at the back.

entries.english_definition: A piece of furniture with doors or drawers for storage.

entries.burmese_meaning: အလုပ်လုပ်၍ ဝင်ငွေရရှိသည်
