entries.example_sentence: Students actively participated in the discussion.

entries.english_definition: Something valuable or useful that a person or organisation owns or has.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပိုင်ဆိုင်မှု၊ တန်ဖိုးရှိသောအရာ
entries.example_sentence: Reliable staff are an important asset to the company.

entries.english_definition: A responsibility or problem that is difficult to carry or deal with.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဝန်ထုပ်ဝန်ပိုး
entries.example_sentence: The extra cost placed a burden on small firms.

entries.english_definition: A formal written document that sets out an organisation's rights or aims.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပဋိညာဉ်စာတမ်း၊ ဖွဲ့စည်းပုံစာတမ်း
entries.example_sentence: The members approved a new charter for the association.

entries.english_definition: A person who is not a member of the armed forces or police.
entries.burmese_meaning: အရပ်သား
entries.example_sentence: The shelter was opened for civilian families.

entries.english_definition: An alliance of groups working together toward a shared aim.
entries.burmese_meaning: မဟာမိတ်အဖွဲ့၊ ပူးပေါင်းအဖွဲ့
entries.example_sentence: Several parties formed a coalition after the election.

entries.english_definition: Causing strong disagreement among people.
entries.burmese_meaning: အငြင်းပွားဖွယ်ဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The proposal remains controversial.

entries.english_definition: The practice of controlling behaviour to follow rules or achieve goals.
entries.example_sentence: Learning a language requires patience and discipline.

entries.english_definition: More powerful, important, or noticeable than others.
entries.example_sentence: One company became dominant in the local market.

entries.english_definition: Used to add another reason or piece of information.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထို့အပြင်
entries.example_sentence: The plan is costly; furthermore, it will take months to finish.

entries.english_definition: An act of entering a country or area by force, especially with an army.
entries.example_sentence: The invasion forced many residents to leave their homes.

entries.english_definition: Very famous and admired, often because of achievements.
entries.example_sentence: The legendary singer performed one final concert.

entries.english_definition: Related to official rules that control an activity or industry.
entries.burmese_meaning: စည်းမျဉ်းစည်းကမ်းထိန်းကြပ်ရေးဆိုင်ရာ
entries.example_sentence: The company must meet regulatory requirements.

entries.english_definition: After something else has happened.
entries.example_sentence: The design was tested and subsequently improved.

entries.english_definition: The process of combining separate parts into a connected whole.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပေါင်းစည်းခြင်း၊ စနစ်တစ်ခုအဖြစ် ချိတ်ဆက်ပေါင်းစည်းမှု
entries.example_sentence: The integration of the two systems reduced duplicate work.

entries.english_definition: The quality of being honest and following strong moral principles.
entries.example_sentence: A leader's integrity matters when difficult decisions arise.

entries.english_definition: A particular explanation of the meaning of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အဓိပ္ပါယ်ဖွင့်ဆိုချက်၊ အနက်ကောက်ယူမှု
entries.example_sentence: Her interpretation of the data differed from the manager's.

entries.english_definition: Allowed by law or accepted as reasonable and fair.
entries.burmese_meaning: တရားဝင်သော၊ သင့်လျော်မှန်ကန်သော
entries.example_sentence: Customers have a legitimate reason to question unclear charges.

entries.english_definition: To publicly support or recommend a particular policy or idea.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထောက်ခံအားပေးသည်၊ အဆိုပြုတိုက်တွန်းသည်
entries.example_sentence: The researchers advocate stricter controls on industrial waste.

entries.english_definition: The legal responsibility for caring for a child or keeping someone detained.
entries.burmese_meaning: အုပ်ထိန်းခွင့်၊ တရားဝင်ထိန်းသိမ်းထားမှု
entries.example_sentence: The court reviewed the arrangements for the child's custody.

entries.english_definition: An amount that is greater than what is needed or allowed.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပိုလျှံသောပမာဏ၊ လိုအပ်သည်ထက်ပိုမှု
entries.example_sentence: The factory recycled the excess material after production.

entries.english_definition: Connected with the practical activities needed to run an organisation or system.
entries.burmese_meaning: လုပ်ငန်းလည်ပတ်မှုဆိုင်ရာ
entries.example_sentence: The new schedule reduced operational delays at the warehouse.

entries.english_definition: The situation of not having paid work while being available to work.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလုပ်လက်မဲ့ဖြစ်မှု၊ အလုပ်လက်မဲ့နှုန်းနှင့်ဆိုင်သောအခြေအနေ
entries.example_sentence: The report examined unemployment among recent graduates.

entries.english_definition: A group of symptoms or conditions that commonly occur together.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရောဂါလက္ခဏာစု
entries.example_sentence: The specialist explained how the syndrome affects sleep.

entries.english_definition: Happening or existing without interruption.
entries.burmese_meaning: မပြတ်မတောက်ဖြစ်သော၊ အဆက်မပြတ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The machine requires continuous monitoring during the test.

entries.english_definition: A careful judgement of quality, value, or performance.
entries.burmese_meaning: အကဲဖြတ်ခြင်း၊ သုံးသပ်အကဲဖြတ်ချက်
entries.example_sentence: The evaluation identified weaknesses in the training programme.

entries.english_definition: Related to an empire or an emperor.
entries.burmese_meaning: အင်ပါယာနှင့်ဆိုင်သော၊ ဧကရာဇ်နှင့်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The museum displayed documents from the imperial period.

entries.english_definition: A person who does an activity for enjoyment rather than as a profession.
entries.burmese_meaning: အပျော်တမ်းလုပ်ဆောင်သူ၊ ဝါသနာရှင်
entries.example_sentence: The amateur photographer won a local prize.

entries.english_definition: A substance that can flow, such as a liquid or gas.
entries.burmese_meaning: စီးဆင်းနိုင်သော အရည် သို့မဟုတ် ဓာတ်ငွေ့
entries.example_sentence: The mechanic checked the brake fluid.

entries.english_definition: Likely to be harmed or affected because of limited protection.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထိခိုက်လွယ်သော၊ အကာအကွယ်အားနည်းသော
entries.example_sentence: Older residents may be vulnerable during extreme heat.

entries.english_definition: A special right or advantage available to a particular person or group.
entries.burmese_meaning: အထူးအခွင့်အရေး၊ အထူးခံစားခွင့်
entries.example_sentence: Access to the private library is a privilege for members.

entries.english_definition: To put a plan, decision, or system into practice.
entries.burmese_meaning: အစီအစဉ် သို့မဟုတ် ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ကို လက်တွေ့အကောင်အထည်ဖော်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The team will implement the new safety procedure next month.

entries.english_definition: Exactly and accurately, without uncertainty.
entries.burmese_meaning: တိတိကျကျ၊ မှန်ကန်တိကျစွာ
entries.example_sentence: Please measure the length precisely before cutting.

entries.english_definition: The identification of an illness or problem through examination.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရောဂါ သို့မဟုတ် ပြဿနာကို စစ်ဆေးဖော်ထုတ်သတ်မှတ်ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: An early diagnosis can help doctors plan treatment.

entries.english_definition: A major change in form, appearance, or character.
entries.example_sentence: The town underwent a transformation after the railway opened.

entries.english_definition: To keep something safe or in its original condition.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထိန်းသိမ်းကာကွယ်သည်၊ မပျက်စီးအောင်ထားသည်
entries.example_sentence: The museum works to preserve historic photographs.

entries.english_definition: Principles about what is right or wrong in behaviour.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကိုယ်ကျင့်တရားဆိုင်ရာ စံနှုန်းများ၊ ကျင့်ဝတ်
entries.example_sentence: The course explores ethics in scientific research.

entries.english_definition: A clear and deep understanding of a situation or problem.
entries.burmese_meaning: အကြောင်းအရာတစ်ခုကို နက်နက်ရှိုင်းရှိုင်း နားလည်သဘောပေါက်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The survey provided insight into customer needs.

entries.english_definition: Continuing for a long time or happening repeatedly, especially of illness or problems.
entries.burmese_meaning: အချိန်ကြာရှည်တည်ရှိသော၊ နာတာရှည်ဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The hospital supports patients with chronic conditions.

entries.english_definition: Achieving useful results through work or discussion.
entries.example_sentence: The discussion was productive because everyone came prepared.

entries.english_definition: The state of being joined together or acting with a shared purpose.
entries.burmese_meaning: စည်းလုံးညီညွတ်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The community showed unity during the recovery effort.

entries.english_definition: A physical or mental condition that can affect a person's ability to do certain activities.
entries.burmese_meaning: မသန်စွမ်းမှု၊ လုပ်ဆောင်နိုင်စွမ်းကို ထိခိုက်စေနိုင်သော အခြေအနေ
entries.example_sentence: The company improved access for people with a disability.

entries.english_definition: A company or person that makes goods, usually in large quantities.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကုန်ပစ္စည်းထုတ်လုပ်သူ၊ ထုတ်လုပ်ရေးကုမ္ပဏီ
entries.example_sentence: The manufacturer recalled the product after discovering a defect.

entries.english_definition: An occasion when money, goods, or services are exchanged.
entries.burmese_meaning: ငွေကြေး သို့မဟုတ် ကုန်ပစ္စည်း အရောင်းအဝယ်ပြုလုပ်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The bank sent a receipt for the transaction.

entries.english_definition: Having long experience in a particular job or activity.
entries.burmese_meaning: လုပ်ငန်းအတွေ့အကြုံရှည်လျားသော၊ ဝါရင့်သော
entries.example_sentence: A veteran journalist led the interview.

entries.english_definition: The system of forcing people to live as property and work without freedom.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူကို ကျွန်အဖြစ်ပိုင်ဆိုင်အသုံးချသော စနစ်
entries.example_sentence: The exhibition examines the history of slavery.

entries.english_definition: Used to introduce another fact or point.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထို့အပြင်၊ နောက်ထပ်အနေဖြင့်
entries.example_sentence: The course covers safety; additionally, it includes practical training.

entries.english_definition: Exactly the same in every detail.
entries.burmese_meaning: လုံးဝတူညီသော
entries.example_sentence: The two documents looked identical, but one had a missing signature.

entries.english_definition: According to the law or in a way recognised by law.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဥပဒေအရ၊ တရားဝင်အားဖြင့်
entries.example_sentence: The agreement is not legally binding until both parties sign.

entries.english_definition: The way a word or expression is normally used.
entries.burmese_meaning: စကားလုံး သို့မဟုတ် အသုံးအနှုန်းတစ်ခု၏ သုံးစွဲပုံ
entries.example_sentence: The dictionary explains the usage of each expression.

entries.english_definition: Relating to a political or economic system favouring social ownership or public control of major resources.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆိုရှယ်လစ်စနစ်နှင့်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The article compares socialist economic policies in different countries.

entries.english_definition: An official document giving permission for a particular activity.
entries.burmese_meaning: တရားဝင်ခွင့်ပြုချက်လက်မှတ်
entries.example_sentence: The contractor applied for a permit before starting work.

entries.english_definition: To show clearly that something is true by giving evidence.
entries.burmese_meaning: အထောက်အထားဖြင့် ရှင်းလင်းစွာ ပြသသည်
entries.example_sentence: The experiment helped demonstrate the theory.

entries.english_definition: Despite what has just been said or happened.
entries.example_sentence: The task was difficult; nonetheless, the team finished it.

entries.english_definition: To stop happening or stop doing something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရပ်ဆိုင်းသည်၊ အဆုံးသတ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The factory will cease operations at the end of the year.

entries.english_definition: As a result of the action just mentioned.
entries.example_sentence: The new process reduces waste, thereby lowering costs.

entries.english_definition: A level at which a particular effect or change begins.
entries.burmese_meaning: သတ်မှတ်အဆင့်၊ အကန့်အသတ်တန်ဖိုး
entries.example_sentence: The alarm sounds when the temperature passes a set threshold.

entries.english_definition: An official decision made by a jury or court about a case.
entries.burmese_meaning: တရားရုံး သို့မဟုတ် ဂျူရီအဖွဲ့၏ ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်
entries.example_sentence: The jury announced its verdict after two days.

entries.english_definition: To stop supporting or continuing a plan or activity.
entries.burmese_meaning: စွန့်လွှတ်သည်၊ ဆက်မလုပ်တော့ဘဲ ရပ်တန့်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The organisers had to abandon the outdoor event because of the storm.

entries.english_definition: To make space for someone or adjust to meet a need.
entries.burmese_meaning: နေရာပေးသည်၊ လိုအပ်ချက်နှင့် ကိုက်ညီအောင် စီစဉ်ပေးသည်
entries.example_sentence: The hall can accommodate two hundred guests.

entries.english_definition: Concerned with beauty or the appearance of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလှအပဆိုင်ရာ
entries.example_sentence: The designer considered both function and aesthetic appeal.

entries.english_definition: A set of defined steps used to solve a problem or process information.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြဿနာဖြေရှင်းရန် သတ်မှတ်ထားသော အဆင့်လိုက်နည်းလမ်း
entries.example_sentence: The search algorithm sorts results by relevance.

entries.english_definition: The state of having many connected parts that are difficult to understand.
entries.example_sentence: The complexity of the contract delayed the agreement.

entries.english_definition: In a way that is planned or intentional.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရည်ရွယ်ချက်ရှိရှိ၊ တမင်တကာ
entries.example_sentence: She deliberately left extra time for questions.

entries.english_definition: The quality of deserving respect and being treated with honour.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဂုဏ်သိက္ခာ
entries.example_sentence: Every patient deserves to be treated with dignity.

entries.english_definition: A set of beliefs or ideas that guides a group or movement.
entries.burmese_meaning: အယူဝါဒ၊ အတွေးအခေါ်စနစ်
entries.example_sentence: The movement was shaped by a particular ideology.

entries.english_definition: The practice of making sure people can take part and feel accepted.
entries.burmese_meaning: အားလုံးပါဝင်နိုင်စေရန် ဆောင်ရွက်ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: The organisation promotes inclusion in the workplace.

entries.english_definition: The state of being separated from other people or places.
entries.example_sentence: Long periods of isolation can affect wellbeing.

entries.english_definition: The land and buildings used by an organisation or business.
entries.burmese_meaning: လုပ်ငန်းတည်ရှိရာ အဆောက်အအုံနှင့် မြေနေရာ
entries.example_sentence: Visitors must sign in before entering the premises.

entries.english_definition: The likelihood that an event will happen.
entries.example_sentence: The probability of rain is higher in the afternoon.

entries.english_definition: A change made to suit new conditions or circumstances.
entries.burmese_meaning: အခြေအနေသစ်နှင့် လိုက်လျောညီထွေဖြစ်အောင် ပြောင်းလဲခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: The adaptation of the course helped more students join.

entries.english_definition: Repeated unwanted behaviour that causes distress or fear.
entries.example_sentence: The company has a policy against workplace harassment.

entries.english_definition: To judge the quality or value of something using evidence.
entries.burmese_meaning: အထောက်အထားအပေါ် မူတည်၍ အကဲဖြတ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Researchers will evaluate the results before publishing them.

entries.english_definition: Following one another without an interruption.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆက်တိုက်ဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: Sales increased for three consecutive months.

entries.english_definition: Done before a more complete examination or decision.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပဏာမဖြစ်သော၊ အကြိုအဆင့်ဖြစ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The preliminary findings suggest that further testing is needed.

entries.english_definition: Certain to happen and impossible to prevent.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရှောင်လွှဲမရသော
entries.example_sentence: Some delays were inevitable during the renovation.

entries.english_definition: Special importance or attention given to something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အထူးအလေးထားမှု
entries.example_sentence: The training places strong emphasis on workplace safety.

entries.english_definition: An official count of the people living in a country or area.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူဦးရေသန်းခေါင်စာရင်း
entries.example_sentence: The national census collects information about households.

entries.english_definition: Situated near or relating to the sea coast.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကမ်းရိုးတန်းနှင့်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: Coastal communities are preparing for stronger storms.

entries.english_definition: Spoken or written remarks that explain or analyse events.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖြစ်ရပ်များအပေါ် သုံးသပ်ရှင်းလင်းချက်
entries.example_sentence: The documentary includes expert commentary on the findings.

entries.english_definition: Financial or practical support for a plan or person.
entries.example_sentence: The research project gained backing from several universities.

entries.english_definition: An influence or connection that affects a decision or situation.
entries.burmese_meaning: သက်ဆိုင်မှု၊ အကျိုးသက်ရောက်မှု
entries.example_sentence: The new evidence has a direct bearing on the final decision.

entries.english_definition: Very noticeable or unusual in an impressive way.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလွန်ထင်ရှားသော၊ မျက်စိကျစရာကောင်းသော
entries.example_sentence: The report revealed a striking difference between the two groups.

entries.english_definition: Only and not involving anything or anyone else.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်ခုတည်းသာ၊ သီးသန့်သာ
entries.example_sentence: The decision was based solely on the test results.

entries.english_definition: To refuse to accept or be changed by something.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခုခံသည်၊ တွန်းလှန်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The committee tried to resist pressure to change its findings.

entries.english_definition: Slowly over a period of time rather than suddenly.
entries.burmese_meaning: တဖြည်းဖြည်း
entries.example_sentence: The water level gradually returned to normal.

entries.english_definition: Many times, often in the same way.
entries.burmese_meaning: အကြိမ်ကြိမ်
entries.example_sentence: The safety instructions were repeatedly explained to the team.

entries.english_definition: Not anticipated or predicted.
entries.example_sentence: An unexpected power failure interrupted the experiment.

entries.english_definition: Relating to a country's congress or its members.
entries.example_sentence: A congressional committee examined the proposal.

entries.english_definition: The events that are believed to be certain to happen in someone's future.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကံကြမ္မာ၊ ရှောင်လွှဲမရသော အနာဂတ်ဖြစ်ရပ်များ
entries.example_sentence: She believed it was her destiny to become a doctor.

entries.english_definition: To start using a new method or idea.
entries.burmese_meaning: နည်းလမ်းအသစ်ကို လက်ခံကျင့်သုံးသည်
entries.example_sentence: The team will adopt a safer procedure.

entries.english_definition: Able to continue without exhausting resources or causing serious harm.
entries.burmese_meaning: သယံဇာတများ မကုန်ခန်းစေဘဲ ရေရှည်ဆက်လက်လုပ်ဆောင်နိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The company is developing a sustainable packaging strategy.

entries.english_definition: To accept or recognise that a fact or problem exists.
entries.burmese_meaning: အချက်အလက် သို့မဟုတ် ပြဿနာတစ်ခု ရှိကြောင်း အသိအမှတ်ပြုသည်
entries.example_sentence: The report must acknowledge the limits of the survey.

entries.english_definition: Providing guidance without making the final decision.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆုံးဖြတ်ပိုင်ခွင့်မရှိဘဲ အကြံပြုလမ်းညွှန်ပေးသော
entries.example_sentence: The university formed an advisory committee.

entries.english_definition: Belonging separately to each person or thing mentioned.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖော်ပြပြီးသော လူ သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခုစီနှင့် သက်ဆိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The managers returned to their respective departments.

entries.english_definition: A possible future situation considered when making plans.
entries.burmese_meaning: စီမံကိန်းရေးဆွဲရာတွင် စဉ်းစားထားသော ဖြစ်နိုင်ခြေရှိသည့် အခြေအနေ
entries.example_sentence: The team prepared a scenario for a supply shortage.

entries.english_definition: To meet the conditions required for a benefit or opportunity.
entries.burmese_meaning: အခွင့်အရေးတစ်ခုအတွက် သတ်မှတ်ချက်ပြည့်မီသည်
entries.example_sentence: Applicants must qualify for the grant before applying.

entries.english_definition: To some extent but not completely.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်စိတ်တစ်ပိုင်းသာ၊ အပြည့်အဝမဟုတ်ဘဲ
entries.example_sentence: The road was partially closed during the repairs.

entries.english_definition: To discover the origin of something by following evidence.
entries.burmese_meaning: အထောက်အထားများကို လိုက်လံစစ်ဆေး၍ မူလရင်းမြစ်ကို ရှာဖွေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Investigators tried to trace the source of the faulty material.

entries.english_definition: An unfair preference for or against a person or group.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး သို့မဟုတ် အုပ်စုတစ်စုအပေါ် ဘက်လိုက်သော သဘောထား
entries.example_sentence: The committee reviewed the process to reduce bias in hiring.

entries.english_definition: The process of arranging things into groups according to shared features.
entries.burmese_meaning: တူညီသော လက္ခဏာများအလိုက် အုပ်စုခွဲသတ်မှတ်ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: The classification of the samples depends on their chemical properties.

entries.english_definition: The feeling of having conflicting attitudes about the same thing.
entries.burmese_meaning: အကြောင်းအရာတစ်ခုတည်းအပေါ် ဆန့်ကျင်ဘက်ခံစားချက်နှစ်မျိုး တစ်ပြိုင်နက် ရှိနေခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: She felt ambivalence about accepting the promotion abroad.

entries.english_definition: Something that seems to belong to a different historical period.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခေတ်ကာလနှင့် မကိုက်ညီဘဲ အခြားခေတ်တစ်ခုမှ ဖြစ်သကဲ့သို့ ထင်ရသော အရာ
entries.example_sentence: The old payment machine looked like an anachronism in the modern shop.

entries.english_definition: A strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခုအပေါ် ပြင်းထန်စွာ မနှစ်သက်ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: His antipathy towards unnecessary rules was well known.

entries.english_definition: To hear both sides of a disagreement and make a decision about it.
entries.burmese_meaning: အငြင်းပွားမှု၏ နှစ်ဖက်စလုံးကို နားထောင်ပြီး ဆုံးဖြတ်ပေးသည်
entries.example_sentence: An independent expert was asked to arbitrate the dispute.

entries.english_definition: Hostile and ready to argue or fight.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရန်လိုပြီး ငြင်းခုံရန် သို့မဟုတ် တိုက်ခိုက်ရန် အသင့်ရှိသော
entries.example_sentence: The passenger became belligerent when staff refused his request.

entries.english_definition: Kind and willing to help other people.
entries.example_sentence: A benevolent donor paid for the village library.

entries.english_definition: The quality of expressing something in few words or lasting briefly.
entries.burmese_meaning: စကားအနည်းငယ်ဖြင့် တိုတောင်းစွာ ဖော်ပြမှု သို့မဟုတ် အချိန်တိုတောင်းမှု
entries.example_sentence: The chairperson appreciated the brevity of her report.

entries.english_definition: Careful to consider possible risks before acting or speaking.
entries.burmese_meaning: လုပ်ဆောင်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ပြောဆိုခြင်းမပြုမီ ဖြစ်နိုင်သည့် အန္တရာယ်များကို သတိထားစဉ်းစားသော
entries.example_sentence: The director was circumspect when discussing the proposed merger.

entries.english_definition: The use of threats or pressure to make someone do something.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ဦးကို တစ်ခုခုလုပ်စေရန် ခြိမ်းခြောက်မှု သို့မဟုတ် ဖိအားပေးမှု
entries.example_sentence: The agreement was invalid because it was signed under coercion.

entries.english_definition: A confusing and difficult problem with no obvious solution.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖြေရှင်းနည်း မထင်ရှားသည့် ရှုပ်ထွေးခက်ခဲသော ပြဿနာ
entries.example_sentence: The council faced a conundrum over housing and transport costs.

entries.english_definition: To provide additional evidence that supports a statement or account.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြောဆိုချက်တစ်ခုကို ထောက်ခံသည့် အထောက်အထား ထပ်မံပေးသည်
entries.example_sentence: The photographs helped corroborate the witness's account.

entries.english_definition: Belief that a claim or explanation is true.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြောဆိုချက် သို့မဟုတ် ရှင်းလင်းချက်တစ်ခု မှန်ကန်သည်ဟု ယုံကြည်လက်ခံမှု
entries.example_sentence: The new data gave credence to the scientist's explanation.

entries.english_definition: Respect shown by accepting another person's judgment or position.
entries.burmese_meaning: အခြားသူ၏ အမြင် သို့မဟုတ် ရာထူးအဆင့်အတန်းကို လေးစား၍ ဦးစားပေးလိုက်နာမှု
entries.example_sentence: Out of deference to the elders, the group waited for their opinion.

entries.english_definition: To describe or mark the exact limits or details of something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အရာတစ်ခု၏ နယ်နိမိတ် သို့မဟုတ် အသေးစိတ်အချက်များကို တိကျစွာ ဖော်ပြသည်
entries.example_sentence: The contract must delineate each supplier's responsibilities.

entries.english_definition: A division between two contrasting ideas or groups.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဆန့်ကျင်ကွဲပြားသော အယူအဆ သို့မဟုတ် အုပ်စုနှစ်ခုအကြား ခွဲခြားမှု
entries.example_sentence: The debate revealed a dichotomy between growth and conservation.

entries.english_definition: To spread information or ideas widely among people.
entries.burmese_meaning: သတင်းအချက်အလက် သို့မဟုတ် အယူအဆများကို လူအများထံ ကျယ်ကျယ်ပြန့်ပြန့် ဖြန့်ဝေသည်
entries.example_sentence: The health agency worked to disseminate clear advice.

entries.english_definition: Combining ideas or styles from many different sources.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရင်းမြစ်အမျိုးမျိုးမှ အယူအဆ သို့မဟုတ် ပုံစံများကို ပေါင်းစပ်ထားသော
entries.example_sentence: The café has an eclectic collection of furniture.

entries.english_definition: The ability of a treatment or method to produce the intended result.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကုသမှု သို့မဟုတ် နည်းလမ်းတစ်ခုက ရည်ရွယ်ထားသည့် ရလဒ်ကို ဖြစ်စေနိုင်စွမ်း
entries.example_sentence: Researchers evaluated the efficacy of the new training method.

entries.english_definition: To add details to make a story or object more attractive, sometimes less accurate.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဇာတ်လမ်း သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခုကို ပိုဆွဲဆောင်မှုရှိစေရန် အသေးစိတ်အချက်များ ထပ်ဖြည့်သည်
entries.example_sentence: He tended to embellish his stories with dramatic details.

entries.english_definition: Regularly found in a particular area or population.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဒေသ သို့မဟုတ် လူအုပ်စုတစ်ခုတွင် ပုံမှန်တွေ့ရှိရသော
entries.example_sentence: The disease is endemic in several tropical regions.

entries.english_definition: A person or thing that is difficult to understand or explain.
entries.burmese_meaning: နားလည်ရန် သို့မဟုတ် ရှင်းပြရန် ခက်ခဲသော လူ သို့မဟုတ် အရာ
entries.example_sentence: The disappearance of the records remains an enigma.

entries.english_definition: Lasting for only a very short time.
entries.burmese_meaning: အချိန်အလွန်တိုတောင်းစွာသာ တည်ရှိသော
entries.example_sentence: The artist used ice to create an ephemeral sculpture.

entries.english_definition: To make an existing problem or unpleasant situation worse.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရှိပြီးသား ပြဿနာ သို့မဟုတ် မကောင်းသောအခြေအနေကို ပိုဆိုးစေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Delaying the repairs could exacerbate the water shortage.

entries.english_definition: To show that someone is not responsible for an alleged wrongdoing.
entries.burmese_meaning: စွပ်စွဲထားသော အမှားအတွက် တာဝန်မရှိကြောင်း သက်သေပြသည်
entries.example_sentence: New evidence helped exonerate the wrongly accused driver.

entries.english_definition: An incorrect belief or argument based on faulty reasoning.
entries.burmese_meaning: မှားယွင်းသော ဆင်ခြင်မှုအပေါ် အခြေခံသည့် အယူအဆ သို့မဟုတ် အငြင်းအခုံအမှား
entries.example_sentence: It is a fallacy to assume that expensive products always last longer.

entries.english_definition: Showing very strong and sincere feelings or beliefs.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြင်းထန်ပြီး စိတ်ရင်းမှန်သော ခံစားချက် သို့မဟုတ် ယုံကြည်ချက်ရှိသော
entries.example_sentence: She was a fervent supporter of public libraries.

entries.english_definition: To motivate people suddenly to take action.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူများကို ရုတ်တရက် စိတ်အားထက်သန်စေပြီး လှုပ်ရှားဆောင်ရွက်စေသည်
entries.example_sentence: The flood warnings helped galvanize local volunteers.

entries.english_definition: Strange because it does not fit the surrounding situation.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပတ်ဝန်းကျင်အခြေအနေနှင့် မကိုက်ညီသောကြောင့် ထူးဆန်းနေသော
entries.example_sentence: The bright plastic sign looked incongruous on the historic building.

entries.english_definition: Careful examination of your own thoughts and feelings.
entries.burmese_meaning: မိမိ၏ အတွေးအမြင်နှင့် ခံစားချက်များကို သေချာစွာ ပြန်လည်ဆန်းစစ်ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: A period of introspection helped her choose a new career.

entries.english_definition: To place two things together to highlight their differences.
entries.burmese_meaning: ကွာခြားချက်များ ပိုမိုထင်ရှားစေရန် အရာနှစ်ခုကို ယှဉ်တွဲထားသည်
entries.example_sentence: Curators juxtapose old photographs with recent ones to show how the town has changed.

entries.english_definition: Extremely careful about small details and accuracy.
entries.burmese_meaning: အသေးစိတ်အချက်များနှင့် တိကျမှုကို အလွန်ဂရုစိုက်သော
entries.example_sentence: Her meticulous records helped the auditors trace every payment.

entries.english_definition: To make the harmful effects of something less serious.
entries.burmese_meaning: အရာတစ်ခု၏ ဆိုးကျိုးသက်ရောက်မှုများကို လျော့နည်းစေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Planting trees can help mitigate extreme summer heat.

entries.english_definition: Showing awareness of small but important differences.
entries.example_sentence: The report offers a nuanced view of migration patterns.

entries.english_definition: Focused on practical solutions rather than abstract ideals.
entries.burmese_meaning: သဘောတရားသက်သက်ထက် လက်တွေ့ကျသော ဖြေရှင်းနည်းများကို အလေးထားသော
entries.example_sentence: They took a pragmatic approach to the budget shortage.

entries.english_definition: An earlier event or decision used as a guide for a similar situation.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလားတူအခြေအနေတွင် စံနမူနာအဖြစ် အသုံးပြုသည့် ယခင်ဖြစ်ရပ် သို့မဟုတ် ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်
entries.example_sentence: The ruling set a precedent for later cases.

entries.english_definition: To examine something very carefully to find important details or problems.
entries.burmese_meaning: အရေးပါသော အသေးစိတ်အချက်များ သို့မဟုတ် ပြဿနာများကို ရှာဖွေရန် သေချာစွာ စစ်ဆေးသည်
entries.example_sentence: Inspectors scrutinize every safety report before approval.

entries.english_definition: Very strict and demanding careful compliance.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလွန်တင်းကျပ်ပြီး စည်းကမ်းကို သေချာလိုက်နာရန် လိုအပ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The laboratory follows stringent hygiene rules.

entries.english_definition: Very determined and unwilling to give up.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလွန်စိတ်ပိုင်းဖြတ်ထားပြီး အလွယ်တကူ လက်မလျှော့သော
entries.example_sentence: The tenacious researcher continued despite repeated setbacks.

entries.english_definition: Present or found almost everywhere.
entries.example_sentence: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in large cities.

entries.english_definition: To show that a person's actions or beliefs were justified.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး၏ လုပ်ရပ် သို့မဟုတ် ယုံကြည်ချက် မှန်ကန်သင့်လျော်ကြောင်း သက်သေပြသည်
entries.example_sentence: The successful trial helped vindicate the engineer's design.

entries.english_definition: To describe someone publicly as very bad or deserving blame.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူတစ်ဦးကို အလွန်ဆိုးရွားသူအဖြစ် လူသိရှင်ကြား ပြစ်တင်ဖော်ပြသည်
entries.example_sentence: The campaign tried to vilify its critics rather than answer them.

entries.english_definition: Playfully unusual or imaginative.
entries.example_sentence: The illustrator filled the book with whimsical animals.

entries.english_definition: Acceptance of a situation without open protest, often unwillingly.
entries.burmese_meaning: မနှစ်သက်သော်လည်း ပွင့်လင်းစွာ မကန့်ကွက်ဘဲ လက်ခံလိုက်ခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: Her silence was mistaken for acquiescence to the new policy.

entries.english_definition: To make a difficult or unpleasant situation better.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခက်ခဲသော သို့မဟုတ် မကောင်းသော အခြေအနေတစ်ခုကို ပိုမိုကောင်းမွန်စေသည်
entries.example_sentence: The new drainage system should ameliorate flooding in the village.

entries.english_definition: Showing active hostility or opposition towards someone.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ဦးအပေါ် ရန်လိုဆန့်ကျင်သည့် သဘောထားရှိသော
entries.example_sentence: His antagonistic remarks made cooperation between the teams harder.

entries.english_definition: The quality of being based on personal choice rather than a fair rule.
entries.burmese_meaning: တရားမျှတသော စည်းမျဉ်းအစား ကိုယ်ပိုင်သဘောအတိုင်း ဆုံးဖြတ်ခြင်း၏ သဘောသဘာဝ
entries.example_sentence: Workers criticised the arbitrariness of the promotion decisions.

entries.english_definition: Showing steady and careful effort over a long period.
entries.burmese_meaning: အချိန်ကြာမြင့်စွာ ဇွဲရှိရှိနှင့် ဂရုတစိုက် ကြိုးစားလုပ်ဆောင်သော
entries.example_sentence: Her assiduous preparation helped the research team avoid errors.

entries.english_definition: A feeling of emotional relief after expressing strong feelings.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြင်းထန်သော ခံစားချက်များကို ဖော်ထုတ်ပြီးနောက် စိတ်ပေါ့ပါးသက်သာလာခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: Writing about the experience gave him a sense of catharsis.

entries.english_definition: To find a way around a rule, restriction or difficulty.
entries.burmese_meaning: စည်းကမ်း၊ ကန့်သတ်ချက် သို့မဟုတ် အခက်အခဲကို လှည့်ပတ်ကျော်လွှားသည်
entries.example_sentence: The company must not circumvent safety checks to save time.

entries.english_definition: To join together to form one group or whole.
entries.burmese_meaning: အစုအဖွဲ့များ ပေါင်းစည်းပြီး တစ်စုတစ်စည်းတည်း ဖြစ်လာသည်
entries.example_sentence: Several small community groups began to coalesce around the proposal.

entries.english_definition: An opinion or explanation based on incomplete evidence.
entries.burmese_meaning: အထောက်အထား မပြည့်စုံသေးချိန်တွင် ခန့်မှန်းထားသော အယူအဆ
entries.example_sentence: Without test results, the cause of the failure remains conjecture.

entries.english_definition: Careful to do work thoroughly and responsibly.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလုပ်ကို တာဝန်သိစွာ အသေးစိတ် ဂရုတစိုက် ဆောင်ရွက်သော
entries.example_sentence: A conscientious inspector records even small defects in the report.

entries.english_definition: Responsibility for a mistake or harmful action.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမှား သို့မဟုတ် ထိခိုက်နစ်နာစေသော လုပ်ရပ်အတွက် အပြစ်တာဝန်ရှိမှု
entries.example_sentence: The investigation examined each manager's culpability in the incident.

entries.english_definition: To speak about someone or something as if they have little value.
entries.burmese_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခု၏ တန်ဖိုးကို နှိမ့်ချပြောဆိုသည်
entries.example_sentence: A professional manager should not disparage colleagues in meetings.

entries.english_definition: Too large or too small in relation to something else.
entries.burmese_meaning: နှိုင်းယှဉ်သည့် အရာနှင့် မမျှတအောင် များလွန်း သို့မဟုတ် နည်းလွန်းသော
entries.example_sentence: The new fee places a disproportionate burden on smaller businesses.

entries.english_definition: A lack of agreement between ideas, values or feelings.
entries.burmese_meaning: အယူအဆများ၊ တန်ဖိုးထားမှုများ သို့မဟုတ် ခံစားချက်များအကြား မညီညွတ်မှု
entries.example_sentence: She felt dissonance between her values and the company's actions.

entries.english_definition: To explain something difficult so that it becomes clear.
entries.burmese_meaning: နားလည်ရခက်သော အကြောင်းအရာကို ရှင်းလင်းနားလည်အောင် ဖော်ပြသည်
entries.example_sentence: The lecturer used a diagram to elucidate the complex process.

entries.english_definition: To establish an attitude or practice so firmly that it is hard to change.
entries.burmese_meaning: အမြင် သို့မဟုတ် လုပ်ထုံးလုပ်နည်းတစ်ခုကို ပြောင်းလဲရခက်အောင် အခိုင်အမာ အမြစ်တွယ်စေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Repeated exceptions can entrench unfair habits in an organisation.

entries.english_definition: Calmness and self-control during difficult situations.
entries.burmese_meaning: ခက်ခဲသော အခြေအနေများတွင် တည်ငြိမ်စိတ်နှင့် မိမိကိုယ်ကို ထိန်းချုပ်နိုင်မှု
entries.example_sentence: She handled the unexpected criticism with remarkable equanimity.

entries.english_definition: To speak unclearly in order to avoid giving a direct answer.
entries.burmese_meaning: တိုက်ရိုက်အဖြေမပေးလိုသဖြင့် မရှင်းမလင်း လှည့်ပတ်ပြောဆိုသည်
entries.example_sentence: The witness began to equivocate when asked about the missing documents.

entries.english_definition: To estimate a wider result from a limited set of known facts.
entries.burmese_meaning: သိရှိထားသော အချက်အလက် အနည်းငယ်မှ ပိုမိုကျယ်ပြန့်သော ရလဒ်ကို ခန့်မှန်းတွက်ချက်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Researchers cannot safely extrapolate national trends from one village.

entries.english_definition: Courage and patience when facing pain or serious difficulty.
entries.burmese_meaning: နာကျင်မှု သို့မဟုတ် ပြင်းထန်သော အခက်အခဲကို ရင်ဆိုင်ရာတွင် ရှိသော သတ္တိနှင့် ခံနိုင်ရည်
entries.example_sentence: The family showed great fortitude during the long recovery.

entries.english_definition: Not intended or planned; happening by accident.
entries.burmese_meaning: ရည်ရွယ်ချက်မရှိဘဲ မတော်တဆ ဖြစ်ပေါ်သော
entries.example_sentence: An inadvertent change to the settings interrupted the presentation.

entries.english_definition: Impossible to change, cancel or take back.
entries.burmese_meaning: ပြန်လည်ပြောင်းလဲ၊ ပယ်ဖျက် သို့မဟုတ် ရုပ်သိမ်း၍ မရနိုင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The agreement becomes irrevocable after the final deadline.

entries.english_definition: To understand someone's words or actions in the wrong way.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ဦး၏ စကား သို့မဟုတ် လုပ်ရပ်ကို အဓိပ္ပာယ်လွဲမှားစွာ နားလည်သည်
entries.example_sentence: Please do not misconstrue my question as criticism of your work.

entries.english_definition: To make information deliberately difficult to understand.
entries.burmese_meaning: သတင်းအချက်အလက်ကို ရည်ရွယ်ချက်ရှိရှိ နားလည်ရခက်အောင် ရှုပ်ထွေးစေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Technical jargon can obfuscate the real reasons for a delay.

entries.english_definition: To cause a situation or belief to continue for a long time.
entries.burmese_meaning: အခြေအနေ သို့မဟုတ် ယုံကြည်ချက်တစ်ခုကို ကြာရှည်ဆက်လက်တည်ရှိစေသည်
entries.example_sentence: Repeating the rumour will only perpetuate the misunderstanding.

entries.english_definition: To give up control, possession or a right.
entries.burmese_meaning: ထိန်းချုပ်ခွင့်၊ ပိုင်ဆိုင်မှု သို့မဟုတ် အခွင့်အရေးကို စွန့်လွှတ်သည်
entries.example_sentence: The founder agreed to relinquish control of daily operations.

entries.english_definition: More than is needed and therefore unnecessary.
entries.burmese_meaning: လိုအပ်သည်ထက် ပိုနေ၍ မလိုအပ်သော
entries.example_sentence: The editor removed superfluous details from the final report.

entries.english_definition: The quality of being especially noticeable or important in a particular situation.
entries.burmese_meaning: အခြေအနေတစ်ခုတွင် အထူးထင်ရှားပြီး အရေးပါနေမှု
entries.example_sentence: The salience of safety concerns increased after the accident.

entries.english_definition: Difficult to understand because the ideas are unusually complex.
entries.burmese_meaning: အယူအဆများ အလွန်ရှုပ်ထွေး၍ နားလည်ရခက်သော
entries.example_sentence: The lecturer explained the abstruse theory with a simple diagram.

entries.english_definition: Marked by bitter anger in speech or disagreement.
entries.burmese_meaning: အငြင်းပွားရာတွင် ခါးသီးသော ဒေါသစကားများ ပါဝင်သော
entries.example_sentence: The meeting ended after an acrimonious argument about funding.

entries.english_definition: Excessive praise or admiration directed towards someone.
entries.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ဦးကို အလွန်အကျွံ ချီးမွမ်းလေးစားခြင်း
entries.example_sentence: The singer found the constant adulation difficult to handle.

entries.english_definition: Friendly and easy to speak to.
entries.burmese_meaning: ဖော်ရွေပြီး စကားပြောဆက်ဆံရလွယ်ကူသော
entries.example_sentence: Despite his senior position, the director remained affable with new staff.

entries.english_definition: Cheerful willingness and speed in doing something.
entries.burmese_meaning: အလုပ်တစ်ခုကို စိတ်အားထက်သန်ပျော်ရွှင်စွာနှင့် လျင်မြန်စွာ ဆောင်ရွက်လိုစိတ်
entries.example_sentence: The volunteers responded with alacrity when help was requested.
